name: PREtendingMD
description: A real-time side-car workflow board for pediatric emergency medicine attending physicians to allow for independence of PEM fellows on shift with pertinent & accessible real-time clinical-thinking & flow management information shared by the pair to track patient flow, team assignments, and disposition with visual indicators. The concept is to have the fellow on shift add in the patients they hear about with a short comment to describe the patient and allow for the attendings to know what has yet to be staffed with them, who is appropriate for disposition, and allow for flagging any steps -Meds/Labs/Imaging/Consultants/PO intake/pain control/ambulation/documents that requires completion prior to determination of patient disposition to allow for real-time tracking as an addition to the EMR rather than as a replacement. The app is to be available on desktop (to allow for quick ptient information entry when taking patient presentations from residents to add the patients to be seen by fellow & attending to the list and assign a resident/APP from the team to the patient for easy tracking. I would like the patient list to exist in a chronological flow with patients added first to be "next up" for the fellow. Once seen by the fellow I want the patient to have a toggle to indicate they have been seen by the fellow and a toggle to visually indicate that the patient has been staffed to the attending. the attending would then also have a toggle to select to indicate they have seen the patient and once seen by the attending physician I want the attending to be able to choose to Discharge/Admit or flag any of the outstanding tasks for attention to complete dispo. I want this to be a multi-user system and I would like to start with 2 roles for each shift- Fellow & Attending. When giving the link to my attending for the shift I want them to be met with a landing screen that allows for First & Last name entry, role selection (fellow, attending), and then grants entry to the dashboard. I also want the list to have the ability to be quick sorted by room number for easy visualization in a different context (when running the list). I want the patients added to the list to provide the information necessary to quickly look at the entry and understand what phase of care they are in and easily access who is provider (resident or APP or med student) for that patient quickly. I also want this to function well on touchscreen mobile devices and want a compact, easy to use, easy to understand system that even the older attending physicians can understand. buttons and toggles need to be intuitive and UI must be effective at conveying the important information in a compact way to allow fellow/attending to touch base quickly and identify needs of the unit.
